description: This file defines the interface and proxy/stub classes for the IUnknown interface in a COM-like architecture within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions for UnknownStub, UnknownStubType, UnknownProxy, and UnknownProxyType, along with related methods for interface handling, reference counting, and message invocation.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations of the IUnknown interface, providing methods for length, conversion, interface ID, and handling messages.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub, representing a specific stub for an interface with associated methods.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing communication and reference counting for remote interface proxies, including methods for acquiring, releasing, and invoking methods.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class implementing the interface, acting as a client-side proxy that forwards calls through UnknownProxy.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of methods or handlers in the stub.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to a Core::IUnknown pointer.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Returns the interface ID associated with the stub.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming messages based on index, channel, and message.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the interface, possibly creating a proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and possibly destroys the proxy.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface by ID.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes a proxy operation, possibly adding or releasing cached implementations.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for a specific method call.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a message on the communication channel.
